result.topic_en: A page of formulas: rapidly converging series for 1/π (Ramanujan-type), a q-product/series identity, a series involving the complete elliptic integral K marked 'not proved', infinite products related to the Gudermannian, and a q-series identity for a ratio of infinite products.
result.transcription:
(111)
(1) $\frac{9}{5} + \sqrt{\frac{9}{5}} = 3.14164\cdots = \pi + .00005$.
(2). $\frac{4}{\pi} = 1 + \frac{7}{4}\cdot\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^3 + \frac{13}{4^2}\cdot\left(\frac{1.3}{2.4}\right)^3 + \frac{19}{4^3}\cdot\left(\frac{1.3.5}{2.4.6}\right)^3 + \cdots$
(3). $\frac{16}{\pi} = 5 + \frac{47}{64}\cdot\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^3 + \frac{89}{64^2}\cdot\left(\frac{1.3}{2.4}\right)^3 + \frac{131}{64^3}\left(\frac{1.3.5}{2.4.6}\right)^3 + \cdots$
(4) $8\frac{(1+\sqrt5)}{\pi} = (6+\sqrt5) + (66+19\sqrt5)\cdot\left(\frac12\right)^3\cdot\frac{1}{64}\cdot\left(\frac{\sqrt5-1}{2}\right)^8 +$
$(126+37\sqrt5)\cdot\left(\frac{1.3}{2.4}\right)^3\cdot\frac{1}{64^2}\cdot\left(\frac{\sqrt5-1}{2}\right)^{16} + \cdots$

$\prod_{r=1}^{r=\infty}\left\{\frac{\left(1+\frac{ak^{r-1}}{n}\right)(1+bk^{r-1}n)}{(1-ak^{r-1})(1-bk^{r-1})}\cdot\frac{1-k^r}{1+nk^r}\cdot\frac{1-k^r}{1+\frac{k^r}{n}}\right\}$
[-$=(1+n)\{\ 1$-] $= 1 + (1+n)\sum_{r=1}^{r=\infty}\left(\frac{a^r}{n+k^r} + \frac{b^r}{1+nk^r}\right)$
where $k = ab$

$\frac{\pi n K}{2}\left\{\frac{1}{(nK)^2} + 4\sum_{r=1}^{r=\infty}\frac{q^r}{1+q^{2r}}\cdot\frac{1}{(nK)^2+(\pi r)^2}\right\}$
$= \frac{1}{n} + \frac{(k)^2}{n} + \frac{2^2}{n} + \frac{(3k)^2}{n} + \frac{4^2}{n} + \frac{(5k)^2}{n+}\cdots$ not proved

If $\frac{\pi\alpha}{2} = gd\left(\frac{\pi\beta}{2}\right)$, then
$\left(\frac{1^2-\alpha^2}{1^2+\beta^2}\right)\cdot\left(\frac{3^2+\beta^2}{3^2-\alpha^2}\right)^3\cdot\left(\frac{5^2-\alpha^2}{5^2+\beta^2}\right)^5\cdot\left(\frac{7^2+\beta^2}{7^2-\alpha^2}\right)^7\cdots\cdots = e^{-\frac{\pi\alpha\beta}{2}}$.
$\{(1+x)e^{-x}\}\{(1+\frac{x}{4})^4e^{-x}\}\{(1+\frac{x}{9})^9e^{-x}\}\cdots\cdots = e^{\frac{x}{2}}$
if $x = \left\{\frac{\log\left(\frac{1+\sqrt5}{2}\right)}{\pi}\right\}^2$

$\frac{(1+ax)(1+ax^2)(1+ax^3)\cdots}{(1-bx)(1-bx^2)(1-bx^3)\cdots}$
$= 1 + \frac{(a+b)x}{(1-x)(1-bx)} + \frac{(a+b)(a+bx)x^3}{(1-x)(1-x^2)(1-bx)(1-bx^2)} +$
$\frac{(a+b)(a+bx)(a+bx^2)x^6}{(1-x)(1-x^2)(1-x^3)\cdot(1-bx)(1-bx^2)(1-bx^3)} + \cdots$

methods.what: Ramanujan-type series for 4/π with cubed central binomial ratios
Series for 8(1+√5)/π involving powers of the golden-ratio conjugate
Infinite product equals a Lambert-type series (bilateral q-series identity) with k=ab
Series involving elliptic integral K and nome q equated to a continued fraction
Infinite product identity under Gudermannian relation
Infinite product evaluation at x = (log golden ratio / π)^2
q-series expansion of ratio of infinite products (q-binomial type)

items.english: The identity relating the K-series to the continued fraction is not proved.
